## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit, for example `fix(core): keep evicted scopes evictable`
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased, or the PR has the `skip-changelog` label
- [ ] No breaking change, or the title uses `!` and the changelog lists it under Changed
